snippet.title: BodyRecords - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
BodyRecords is launches in Early Access and to celebrate, we’re giving you 40% off at launch! 🎉

Core features:

Bodycam View – Intense first-person realism.
Mic Sensitivity – Your voice can save or doom you.
Puzzles – Solve to uncover secrets and survive.
Co-op – Teamwork is your only lifeline.
Backrooms – Death leads to a second chance… maybe.

#steam #gaming #horror #extraction #earlyacces #release
